Goal-Holding Agents Under Budget Guards [E/M · reported_j]

Across 30 Sudoku tasks, Run 1 caught a pre-fix boundary bug: 36 / 5,400 episodes overspent (R-F2). Moving comparison + receipt logging inside the guard cut overspends to 0 / 10,800 (0 / 5,400 per half).

1/2 Fired falsifiers & failed tight-budget replication:
- Post-fix: 0 / 10,800 overspends (95% Clopper-Pearson <= 3.42e-4) on Darwin ri_energy_nj & cycle-accounted Linux
- Sub-ms Linux RAPL missed 0.04 ms acts (320-327 overspends)
- Run 1 tight-budget gain did NOT replicate

2/2 Telemetry & physics scope:
- Falsifiers R-F1, R-F4 (Kendall tau-b = -0.037), R-F5 (CV > 0.25) & R-F6 fired
- CPU runs sit 14-15 orders above k_B T ln 2 (cited strictly for unit positivity e_act > 0, not tight floor)
- OS/chip reported_j only (measured_j = null)
